surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: The Predators beat the Stars
paras: Mavrik Bourque scored his first goal for Nashville with just under a minute left in the first to open the scoring. Ross Colton added the empty-netter with less than two minutes left to make it 2-0. With the goalie pulled and 35 seconds left, Wyatt Johnston pulled the Stars within one, and Jack Drury ended any hope of a comeback with an empty-netter with 15 seconds left.

The Predators had a bit more of the good stuff, outshooting the Stars 27-21. Juuse Saros made 20 saves for the Predators, and Jake Oettinger kept the Stars in it, stopping 24 of 25. The Preds moved to 13-6-5, fourth in the Central, while the Stars dropped to 15-7-2, second in the Central.
